run_submitit_linprobe: run the MAE linear probe training job on a multi-node Slurm cluster using submitit
run_trainer_call: run the Trainer callable to set up GPU args and start linear probe classification training
create_trainer_checkpoint: create a Trainer checkpoint that requeues the job with a fresh init file and resume path
parse_args_submitit: parse command line args for MAE linear probe including ngpus, nodes, timeout, and partition
get_init_file: get a unique init file URI for distributed training process group initialization
